_comment: RECOGNIZABILITY prune — guitar/drum-tab 'canon' that musicians know but the general public doesn't: metal/shred showpieces, guitar instrumentals, and deep album cuts by famous artists. Different rationale from exclude.json (no-meaningful-tempo songs); applied as a build-time filter (survives re-seed). Hand-curated by recognizability JUDGMENT, NOT by popularity score — the 45/0/55 score is too biased/compressed to trust (famous pop/disco/hip-hop sit as low as deep cuts). Only Songsterr/Ultimate-Guitar-sourced songs were pruned; hand-added extra_songs.json entries were left alone. Key = 'artist|title' (normalized at load). Delete a line to re-include a song.
